Named UA payment-infrastructure operator; standalone site covering terminal/payment-acceptance network.

Mastercard IR feed, same scheme-level disclosure value for the UA card market.
Specialist Ukrainian payments trade media; continuous early-warning stream over official releases.

Archive of DGF annual reports gives the multi-year back series; standalone document repository.
Continuously refreshed DGF statistics dashboard usable for market-sizing denominators.
Register of completed liquidations — definitive dated market-exit event log.
Register of banks sold to investors/state — actual UA banking M&A outcomes.
Per-bank DGF portals with uniform structure; one scraper yields failed-bank financials, claims and asset listings.

Rental sub-section of the same fg.gov.ua asset area already covered by the asset-sale source.

Resolution methodology plus live investor competitions — forward-looking pipeline of market exits.
Single dated article in a recurring series; cite as evidence and monitor the press-release feed instead.
Public debtor register of banks in liquidation; standalone queryable register, moderate analytic value.
Litigation tracker against ex-owners; distinctive ownership/governance intelligence updated over time.
Executive-directorate decision register — earliest legally operative signal of a bank's exit.

English DGF mirror useful for terminology and citable framing; thinner and slower than the UA site.
Prozorro.Sale bankrupt-bank auction database with lot-level outcomes and open data; standalone platform.
Single Accounting Chamber audit PDF; strong evidence — monitor the rp.gov.ua reports hub for the series.
